answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks using sequential proof-of-work challenges across an adversarial peer-to-peer tundra. Rejecting ivory tower assumptions of honesty, nodes require each participant to solve non-parallelizable delay functions, forcing attackers to burn scarce processor time per identity. This barrier prevents an adversary from spawning even a lightweight sparrow swarm cheaply. However, the mechanism inherently squanders energy and penalizes resource-constrained devices.
